Why Caribbean payroll technology needs local rules

TriblockHR illustrates the challenge of building systems around multiple statutory regimes.

BY CARIBBEAN BUSINESS ATLAS · COMMENTARY & COMPANY RESEARCH

Payroll software designed for a single country does not automatically handle the rules used across Caribbean markets. Employers deal with different statutory deductions, filing requirements, pay practices and banking systems.

TriblockHR describes an HR and payroll platform designed in Nassau for businesses operating across several territories. Its site lists employee records, attendance, payroll and statutory reporting as part of its offering.

This is a company-product analysis rather than an independent software review. Customer figures, claimed savings, compliance and security certifications require separate verification before a comparative ranking can be published.
